mesh.refinement: nested simplex subdivision with inherited materials

physical.property_policy: Material properties are frozen at reference_temperature_K.
physical.flow_policy: Prescribed axisymmetric P2 Stokes velocity, frozen for all queries and time slabs.

parameters.scope: Self-built geometry with prescribed flow; thermal optimization uses a separate P1 discretization.

memory.measurement: sampled process RSS and NVML compute-process GPU allocation
memory.sampler: separate process; unaffected by the solver interpreter lock

timing_scope: assembly, reference construction, all PDAS steps and inner solves, transfers, verification, solver cleanup; field serialization and common startup excluded
